Two landmark phase III trials establish PCV chemotherapy added to radiotherapy as standard of care: EORTC 26951 (van den Bent et al. JCO 2013 / 12-yr update Cairncross JCO 2013): 374 pts, anaplastic oligodendroglioma; RT alone vs RT + PCV; in the 1p/19q-codeleted subgroup: mOS 14+ yr with RT+PCV vs 9.3 yr RT alone (HR ~0.5). Benefit confined to codeleted tumors. RTOG 9802 (Shaw et al. NEJM 2012 / 10-yr update): low-risk LGG subset; RT+PCV vs RT alone; 10-yr OS 73.8% vs 60.1% (HR 0.59, p=0.003). 1p/19q-codeleted patients derived greatest benefit. For grade 2 oligodendroglioma, temozolomide (TMZ) is an alternative to PCV (less neurotoxicity, shorter course) — EORTC 22033-26033 trial showed no OS advantage of TMZ monotherapy over RT but equal outcomes in codeleted tumors. Phase-3 Lancet 2018 (Lancet 2018;392:2088; Lancet Haematology 2020;7:e552 5-yr follow-up): mOS 9.56 vs 5.95 mo for 7+3, HR 0.69; 5-yr OS 18% vs 8%. Eligibility window age 60-75 + fit-for-intensive-chemo. Routes 1L AML to CPX-351-SECONDARY indication over standard 7+3 when this RF fires.
: AML patient frail or elderly unfit for: : AML patient frail or elderly unfit for intensive induction: age ≥75, OR age ≥65 with ≥2 comorbidities (HCT-CI ≥3), OR ECOG ≥2 with multiple comorbidities, OR explicit clinical assessment 'unfit for intensive chemotherapy'
: AML with FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutation: : AML with FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutation — addition of midostaurin (or gilteritinib in r/r) to induction is required (RATIFY trial)
: AML with core-binding-factor (CBF) cyt: : AML with core-binding-factor (CBF) cytogenetics: t(8;21)(q22;q22.1) with RUNX1::RUNX1T1 fusion OR inv(16)(p13.1q22) / t(16;16)(p13.1;q22) with CBFB::MYH11 fusion. ~10-15% of de novo adult AML, ~25% of pediatric AML. ELN 2022 favorable risk; standard 7+3 induction + 3-4 cycles HiDAC consolidation is curative-intent in CR1 (5-year OS 60-75%); upfront alloHCT is NOT recommended in CR1 default. Adding gemtuzumab ozogamicin to induction (ALFA-0701, AML-19) further improves OS specifically in CBF AML (HR 0.69). c-KIT mutations (D816, exon-8) co-occur in ~25% of CBF AML and may downgrade favorability — warrant MRD-directed approach.
: APL with Sanz high risk — WBC >10 ×10^: : APL with Sanz high risk — WBC >10 ×10^9/L at diagnosis — supports ATRA+ATO+idarubicin (or +gemtuzumab in selected protocols); higher early-death risk and warrants leukapheresis-avoidance + aggressive DIC management
: APL with active disseminated intravasc: APL com coagulação intravascular difundida ativa (DIC): fibrinogênio < 150 mg/dL, TPT/PTT prolongada, dímero D elevado, trombocitopenia + manifestações sangrantes. Iniciar ATRA A SUSPICIÃO CLÍNICA antes da confirmação citogenética.
: Acquired EGFR T790M (gatekeeper) mutat: : A mutação adquirida do EGFR T790M (gatekeeper) na progressão do EGFR-TKI 1st/2nd-gen (gefitinib, erlotinib, afatinib, dacomitinib) — impulsiona uma mudança de 2L para o osimertinib (AURA3 — mPFS 10,1 vs 4,4 mo com pem platinado).
: Actionable molecular driver detected (: : Condutor molecular acionável detectado (EGFR / ALK / ROS1 / KRAS G12C / BRAF V600E / MET ex14 / RET / NTRK / HER2 mut) — o condutor-alvo TKI / ADC tem precedência sobre o ICI ± quimioterapia independentemente do PD-L1 TPS.
: Active or recent (≤6 months) variceal: : Hemorragia variceal ativa ou recente (≤6 meses) em paciente com CHC com cirrose. Mandatos EGD avaliação + ligadura de banda variceal ANTES de qualquer regime contendo bevacizumab (atezo+bev, pré-requisito IMbrave150).
: Advanced/metastatic gastric or GE-junc: : Adenocarcinoma gástrico avançado/metástatico ou adenocarcinoma de junção GE com PD-L1 escore positivo combinado (CPS) ≥1 por 22C3 IHC. CheckMate-649 (Janjigian Lancet 2021; OS final 2024) estabeleceu nivolumab + quimioterapia (FOLFOX ou XELOX) em monoterapia para CPS ≥5 (mOS 14,4 vs 11,1 mo, HR 0,71) com benefício contínuo em CPS ≥1 (HR 0,78). A FDA aprovou nivolumab + quimioterapia para HER2-negativo adenocarcinoma gástrico/GEJ 1L independentemente de CPS; EMA restringe a CPS ≥5. NCCN/ESMO 2024 favorecem a adição de nivolumab para FOLFOX/XELOX para CPS ≥1 (com maior preferência para CPS ≥5).
: Age >70 OR ECOG ≥3 OR CrCl 50-70 mL/mi: : Idade >70 OU ECOG ≥3 OU CrCl 50-70 ml/min — dose completa HD-MTX (≥3,5 g/m2) tem toxicidade excessiva; dose reduzida MTX (1-3 g/m2) ± rituximab considerado.
: Age ≥80 + ECOG ≥2 — nivo+ipi prohibiti: : Idade ≥80 + ECOG ≥2 — nivo+ipi proibitivo; nivo+rela ou pembro mono.
: BRAF V600E mutation in NSCLC adenocarc: : BRAF V600E mutation in NSCLC adenocarcinoma — ~1-2% prevalence. Dabrafenib + trametinib (BRF113928 — ORR 64% 1L, 63% 2L+) is the approved targeted regimen; encorafenib + binimetinib (PHAROS) is newer alternative. Non-V600 BRAF mutations are not actionable with these doublets.
: BRAF V600E mutation in mCRC: ~8-10% pr: : mutação BRAF V600E no mCRC: prevalência de ~8-10%, prognóstico ruim (mediana OS metade vs BRAF-WT na quimioterapia padrão). Cetuximab/panitumumab ineficaz. Encorafenib + cetuximab (BEACON CRC) é preferido 2L+; alguns dados de 1L favorecem FOLFOXIRI + intensificação bev no MSS BRAF-mutante.
: BRAF V600E or V600K activating mutatio: : BRAF V600E ou V600K ativando a mutação em melanoma metastático / irresecável — ~40-50% prevalência melanoma cutâneo. Definição do tratamento: BRAFi + MEKi duplot (dabrafenib + trametinib, encorafenib + binimetinib — COLUMBUS, vemurafenib + cobimetinib). Sequenciamento com anti-PD-1 (CheckMate-067, DREAMseq) — IO-primeiro preferido em doença de baixo volume; BRAF+MEK primeiro em doença sintomática / alta LDH.
: BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant (ger: : BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic variant (germline OR somatic) in high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma — ~20-25% prevalence (15% germline + ~7% somatic). Olaparib maintenance after platinum-based 1L (SOLO-1 — mPFS 56.0 vs 13.8 mo BRCA-mut) is treatment-defining; rucaparib + niraparib alternatives. SOLO-2 — 2L+ relapse maintenance.
: Bulky lymphoma disease: single nodal m: : Doença do linfoma bulkky: massa nodal única >=7 cm OR massa mediastinal >1/3 diâmetro torácico OR carga sintomática significativa
: Burkitt lymphoma high-risk features: H: : Linfoma de Burkitt características de alto risco: HIV+ E CD4 < 100 OU ECOG ≥3 OU LDH >3× Acometimento do LSN ou doença abdominal voluminosa — seleciona mais intensiva CODOX-M/IVAC sobre DA-EPOCH-R
: CLL with del(17p) by FISH AND/OR TP53: : CLL with del(17p) by FISH AND/OR TP53 mutation by NGS — ~5-10% at diagnosis, rising to ~30-40% in R/R disease. Defines a chemoimmuno- refractory subset (FCR/BR contraindicated; chemo OS <2 years). 1L selection narrows to two targeted-only routes: continuous BTKi (acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib, ibrutinib) OR fixed-duration venetoclax + obinutuzumab (CLL14, Fischer NEJM 2019; del(17p)/TP53-mut subgroup mPFS >5 years). NCCN/ESMO 2024 prefer fixed-duration ven + obinutuzumab over continuous BTKi for patient-preference and cardiac/bleeding-risk profiles, while continuous BTKi preferred for high disease bulk or patients unable to tolerate TLS-prophylaxis ramp.
: CLL with high-risk genetics: TP53 muta: : CLL com genética de alto risco: mutação TP53 OR del(17p) OR IGHV-unmutated OR cariótipo complexo (≥3 anormalidades)
: CML chronic phase with Sokal high risk: : CML chronic phase with Sokal high risk — supports 2nd-generation TKI 1L (dasatinib / nilotinib / bosutinib) over imatinib for faster MMR/MR4.5 and improved long-term cumulative incidence of progression
: CML high-risk by ELTS (EUTOS Long-Term: : CML high-risk by ELTS (EUTOS Long-Term Survival score) — favors 2nd-generation TKI (nilotinib / dasatinib / bosutinib) over imatinib for faster deep molecular response and improved long-term outcomes
: CML in accelerated or blast phase: ≥10: : CML in accelerated or blast phase: ≥10% blasts in PB or BM (accelerated), ≥20% blasts (blast phase), or extramedullary blasts. Treatment intent shifts from chronic-phase TKI to acute-leukemia-style induction + alloHCT.
: CML with T315I gatekeeper mutation in: : CML with T315I gatekeeper mutation in the BCR-ABL1 kinase domain — resistant to all 1st/2nd-gen TKIs; requires ponatinib or asciminib (STAMP)
: CXCR4 WHIM-like nonsense or frameshift: : Absurdo semelhante ao CXCR4 WHIM ou mutação frameshift no domínio regulatório terminal C (por exemplo, S338X, R334X) na macroglobulinemia de Waldenström (WM). As mutações semelhantes ao CXCR4 WHIM ocorrem com o MYD88 L265P em ~30-40% do MYD88-mutante WM e causam sinalização constitutiva CXCR4 através da perda do domínio regulatório terminal C. Estas mutações conferem resistência relativa a inibidores da BTK (BTKi) em monoterapia — menor taxa de resposta global e maior taxa de resposta, menor cinética de declínio da IgM em comparação com a CXCR4-WT MYD88-mutante WM (Treon NEJM 2015; Castillo Blood 2020). Fogos para a via ALGO-WM-2L passo 1 para a terapêutica com base em carfilzomib (IND-WM-2L-CARFILZOMIB-CXCR4MUT) em vez de zanubrutinib BTKi em monoterapia (IND-WM-2L-ZANUBRUTINIB), uma vez que a eficácia da BTKi é substancialmente atenuada em CXCR4-mutado WM. Detecção: CXCR4 C-terminal sequenciamento por PCR alvo + painel Sanger ou NGS com cobertura C-terminal CXCR4. Nota: painel NGS padrão frequentemente omite CXCR4 C-terminal; ensaio dedicado necessário. Aspirado de medula óssea com CD138+ enriquecimento preferido para representação adequada do clone WM. Teste de mutação CXCR4 é recomendado no diagnóstico WM por Linfomas NCCN B-Cell 2025 (além do MYD88 L265P) para guiar a seleção inicial da terapia. Em pacientes com CXCR4-mutados, a resposta em monoterapia com BTKi é atenuada; os regimes baseados em inibidores de proteassomos ou BR são preferidos 1L por NCCN/ESMO. Em 2L, os regimes baseados em carfilzomib oferecem benefício em BTKi-refratário ou BTKi-intolerante CXCR4-mutado WM.
: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma stage III-I: : Linfoma Hodgkin clássico estágio III-IV (avançado) — seleciona A+AVD (ECHELON-1) sobre ABVD se o brentuximab acessível
: DLBCL with International Prognostic In: : DLBCL com Índice Prognóstico Internacional 4-5 (alto risco) — suporta a intensificação da Pola-R-CHP por POLARIX e desencadeia a discussão da profilaxia CNS através do CNS-IPI
: DLBCL com índice de prognóstico internacional ≥2 — seleciona o Pola-R-CHP intensificado sobre o R-CHOP por evidência de POLARIX
: EGFR exon 19 deletion is the most comm: : A deleção do exon 19 do EGFR é a mutação mais comum de sensibilidade ao EGFR no adenocarcinoma NSCLC (~45-50% dos casos de mutante do EGFR). A terapia direta 1L aprovada pela FDA/EMA é o osimertinib (FLAURA — mPFS 18,9 vs 10,2 mo, OS 38,6 vs 31,8 mo); MARIPOSA-2 estabelece 2L amivantamab + lazertinib + quimioterapia pós-osimertinib progressão.
: EGFR exon 20 insertion — heterogeneous: : EGFR exon 20 insertion — heterogeneous in-frame insertions that sterically block 1st/2nd/3rd-gen EGFR-TKI binding. Targeted by amivantamab (EGFR-MET bispecific; CHRYSALIS / PAPILLON) and mobocertinib (where available). PAPILLON established 1L amivantamab + carboplatin/pemetrexed; CHRYSALIS supports 2L+ amivantamab monotherapy.
: ESR1 ligand-binding-domain mutation (D: : mutação do domínio ligante-ligando-ESR1 (D538G, Y537S/N/C, L536H, E380Q) adquirida em ~30-40% dos cânceres de mama metastáticos HR+/HER2- progredindo no inibidor da aromatase. Preditivo para elacestrant (SERD oral; EMERALD — mPFS 3,8 vs 1,9 mo no subgrupo ESR1-mut) pós-AI.
: FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in advan: : FGFR2 fusion or rearrangement in advanced/metastatic intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (~10–20% of iCCA; rare in extrahepatic / gallbladder). Treatment-defining for 2L+: pemigatinib (FIGHT-202 ORR 35.5%, mPFS 6.9 mo, mOS 21.1 mo; FDA Apr 2020) preferred when FGFR2 fusion confirmed; futibatinib (FOENIX-CCA2) covalent FGFR-TKI alternative, including some pemigatinib-resistance variants. Common partners: BICC1-FGFR2, FGFR2-AHCYL1, FGFR2-CCDC6.
: Fit performance status (ECOG 0-1): pat: : Situação de desempenho (ECOG 0-1): o paciente é totalmente ativo ou restrito em atividade física endurecida, mas ambulatório e capaz de realizar um trabalho leve. Elegível para quimioterapia em dose completa e regimes intensivos (CHOEP, escalada de BEACOPP, HD-MTX, consolidação ASCT, CAR-T).
: Fitness for FOLFIRINOX in metastatic P: : Fitness for FOLFIRINOX in metastatic PDAC per PRODIGE-4 / ACCORD-11 inclusion criteria (Conroy NEJM 2011): ECOG 0-1, age ≤75 (≤76 by protocol; convention <=70-75 in real-world), bilirubin ≤1.5× ULN (resolved post-biliary stenting if needed), no significant cardiac comorbidity, adequate hepatic / renal / bone-marrow function. Selects IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-FOLFIRINOX over IND-PDAC-METASTATIC-1L-GEM-NAB-PAC (mOS 11.1 vs 6.8 mo in PRODIGE-4; toxicity tradeoff acceptable in fit patients). Frail / ECOG ≥2 / bilirubin elevated → de-escalate to gem-nab-paclitaxel (MPACT, Von Hoff NEJM 2013).
: Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expre: : Folate receptor alpha (FRα) high expression (≥75% of viable tumor cells with ≥2+ membrane staining by VENTANA FOLR1 RxDx) in platinum-resistant high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma. Mirvetuximab soravtansine (MIRASOL — mPFS 5.6 vs 4.0 mo, OS 16.5 vs 12.7 mo vs investigator-choice chemo) is FDA-approved 2L+ ADC.
: Follicular lymphoma NOT meeting any GE: : Follicular lymphoma NOT meeting any GELF criterion — low tumor burden — watch-and-wait candidate; no survival benefit shown for early treatment in asymptomatic low-burden FL
: Follicular lymphoma meeting GELF crite: : Linfoma folicular que cumpre os critérios do GELF para alta carga tumoral — qualquer um dos seguintes valores: massa nodal ≥7 cm; ≥3 locais nodais cada ≥3 cm; sintomas B; esplenomegalia abaixo do umbilico; derrame pleural/peritoneal; citopenia (Hb <10, plt <100K, ANC <1,5K) atribuível ao linfoma; LDH >ULN; β2M elevada; doença rapidamente progressiva
: Follicular lymphoma meeting any GELF c: : Linfoma folicular que cumpre qualquer critério GELF - alta carga tumoral que justifique a terapia sistêmica 1L (R-CHOP / BR / R-CVP / R2) em vez de vigiar e esperar
: Follicular lymphoma with clinical feat: : Linfoma folicular com características clínicas relacionadas com a transformação para linfoma agressivo (tipicamente DLBCL): progressão rápida da doença, massa nodal de crescimento rápido isolado, aumento súbito da LDH, novos sintomas B, hipercalcemia, início do envolvimento extranodal
: Germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 pathogenic var: : Germlina BRCA1 ou BRCA2 variante patogênica em HER2-negativo câncer de mama (HR+ ou TNBC). Olaparib (OlympiAD — mPFS 7,0 vs 4,2 mo vs quimioterapia) e talazoparib (EMBRAC — mPFS 8,6 vs 5,6 mo) são aprovados pela FDA para a mama metastática gBRCA HER2-negativa. Olaparib adjuvante (OlympiA) para a mama precoce HER2-negativa de alto risco.
: Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 mutation O: : mutação germlina ou somática BRCA1/2 OU alteração mais ampla da via HRR (ATM, CDK12, PALB2, etc.) — prediz resposta PARPi; abre indicação olaparib/talazoparib em mCRPC.
: HCV RNA PCR mandatory at SMZL diagnosi: : A PCR do RNA do VHC é obrigatória no diagnóstico de SMZL — a SMZL impulsionada pelo VHC responde a antivíricos de ação direta (DAA) com regressão em 50-75%; o rituximab diferiu até que a resposta antivírica foi avaliada.
: HER2 (ERBB2) activating exon-20 mutati: : HER2 (ERBB2) ativando mutação exon-20 no adenocarcinoma NSCLC — prevalência ~2-3%; diferente da amplificação ou sobreexpressão do HER2. Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd; DESTINY-Lung01/02 — ORR 49-58%) é o ADC alvo aprovado pela FDA 2L+. HER2-amp / IHC-somente NSCLC tem dados de resposta T-DXd mais fracos — mutação do domínio da quinase é o melhor biomarcador preditivo.
: HER2 amplification / overexpression in: : amplificação HER2 / excesso de expressão no câncer de mama (IHC 3+ OR IHC 2+ com amplificação ISH) — ~15-20% da mama invasiva. Define a faixa de tratamento HER2 positivo: trastuzumab + pertuzumab + quimioterapia (CLEOPATRA 1L), T-DXd 2L (DESTINY-Breast03 — mPFS 28,8 vs 6,8 mo vs T-DM1).
: HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC: : HER2-low breast cancer (IHC 1+ OR IHC 2+ with non-amplified ISH) — ~50-55% of HER2-non-positive breast cancers. T-DXd 2L+ approved in HR+ and TNBC HER2-low post-chemo (DESTINY-Breast04 — mPFS 9.9 vs 5.1 mo, OS 23.4 vs 16.8 mo).
: IDH1 R132 mutation in intrahepatic cho: : IDH1 R132 mutação no colangiocarcinoma intra- hepático após progressão gemcitabine/cisplatin- Terapia baseada. 2L revisão da terapêutica direcionada para ivosidenib.
: IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutatio: : IDH2 R140Q or R172K activating mutation in AML — ~8-12% prevalence. Enasidenib (IDHIFA / IDHENTIFY — phase-3 R/R AML; monotherapy ORR 38%, CR 19%) is FDA-approved for R/R-AML-IDH2; also active 1L combination with azacitidine in unfit (AG221-AML-005 — ORR 71%).
: IMDC (International Metastatic RCC Dat: : IMDC (Consórcio Internacional de Base de Dados de CCR Metástatico) escore de risco intermédio ou ruim em CCR de células claras metastáticas (Heng JCO 2009). Seis fatores adversos: KPS < 80%, tempo do diagnóstico para a terapêutica sistêmica < 1 ano, hemoglobina < menor limite de normalidade (12 g/dL), cálcio corrigido > ULN, neutrófilos > ULN, plaquetas > ULN 0 fatores = favorável; 1-2 = intermediário; ≥3 = ruim. CheckMate-214 (Motzer NEJM 2018) estabeleceu a superioridade do nivolumab + ipilimumab sobre sunitinib para subgrupos de risco intermédio e de risco ruim (mOS 47 vs 26 mo, ITT). KEYNOTE-426 (pembro+axi) benefícios em todos os grupos de risco; nivo+ipi preferido em int/pobre por sinal de resposta duradoura a longo prazo. Rotas ALGO-RCC-METASTATIC-1L passo 1 para IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-NIVO-IPI; risco favorável cai até IND-RCC-METASTATIC-1L-PEMBRO-AXI por defeito.
: Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-ris: : Ifosfamide contraindicated or high-risk in relapsed/refractory Burkitt lymphoma 2L salvage, routing to R-DHAP (cisplatin-based) over R-ICE (ifosfamide-based). Three clinical scenarios: (1) Prior hemorrhagic cystitis — any prior ifosfamide- or cyclophosphamide-related hemorrhagic cystitis is a contraindication to further ifosfamide even with mesna; residual mucosal damage increases bleeding risk; (2) Pelvic RT field overlap — prior irradiation to bladder field dramatically increases ifosfamide-related bladder toxicity; avoid; (3) Pre-existing peripheral neuropathy grade ≥2 — ifosfamide causes both peripheral and central neuropathy; additional neurotoxicity risk unacceptable when baseline neuropathy already impairs function; (4) Bladder outlet obstruction, single kidney, or other bladder structural contraindication to mesna- protected ifosfamide. In these scenarios R-DHAP (dexamethasone 40 mg d1-4 + cytarabine 2 g/m² q12h d2 + cisplatin 100 mg/m² d1) is the preferred platinum salvage — equivalent salvage activity to R-ICE (CORAL trial subgroup) with different toxicity profile (renal/ototoxicity from cisplatin vs bladder/neuropathy from ifosfamide).
: KIT activating mutation (exon 11 / 13): : mutação ativa do KIT (exon 11 / 13) no subtipo de mucosa ou melanoma acral — prevalência ~15-20% nesses subtipos (raro na cutânea). Imatinib (Carvajal 2013 — ORR 23% na mucosa/acra do KIT-mut) e nilotinib são ativos fora do rótulo; integrar com o IO padrão se elegível.
: KMT2A rearrangement (MLL fusion at 11q: : KMT2A rearrangement (MLL fusion at 11q23) in AML — ~5-10% prevalence in adult AML; ELN-2022 adverse-risk classifier. Revumenib (menin inhibitor; AUGMENT-101 phase 1/2) FDA-approved Nov 2024 for relapsed/ refractory KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia after ≥1 prior line (ORR ~63%, CR/CRh ~23%). Ziftomenib alternative menin inhibitor in late-phase trials. Common partners: AF9 (t(9;11)) and AF4 (t(4;11)).
: KRAS G12C mutation — ~13% of NSCLC ade: : mutação KRAS G12C — ~13% do adenocarcinoma NSCLC; associado ao tabagismo. Sotorasib (CodeBreaK 200 — mPFS 5,6 vs 4,5 mo docetaxel) e adagrasib (KRYSTAL-1) são 2L+ inibidores covalentes do G12C aprovados pela FDA. 1L ainda é IO ± quimioterapia por PD-L1 (sem 1L superioridade inibidora do G12C ainda).
: MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biall: : MDS with TP53 mutation (mono- or biallelic) — distinct WHO 5th-ed entity with poor outcomes on HMA monotherapy and reduced alloHCT benefit; consideration of intensified / experimental therapy or palliative intent
: MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q): : MDS with isolated del(5q) (or del(5q) plus one additional non-7 abnormality) — lenalidomide-responsive subgroup with ~67% RBC transfusion independence; favorable prognosis
: MET exon 14 skipping — ~3-4% of NSCLC: : MET exon 14 pulando — ~3-4% de NSCLC adenocarcinoma; mais velho / fumante enriquecido. Capmatinib (GEOMETRY mono-1 — ORR 41-68%) e tepotinib (VISÃO) são MET-TKIs selectivos aprovados pela FDA para uso em qualquer linha. RNA-NGS preferido para detecção de embutidos.
: MF with B2 blood involvement (Sézary c: : MF com envolvimento sanguíneo B2 (contagem de células sézárias ≥1000/μL OR ≥5% Sézary por morfologia) - define Síndrome de Sézary / estágio IVA1; vias para a terapêutica sistémica com preferência mogamulizumab
: MF with large-cell transformation (LCT: : MF with large-cell transformation (LCT — ≥25% large cells on biopsy review) — aggressive variant; mandates systemic therapy reassessment, brentuximab vedotin if CD30+
: MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — treatment-defin: : MSI-high / dMMR mCRC — biomarcador definidor de tratamento. KEYNOTE-177 estabeleceu pembrolizumab 1L sobre FOLFOX+bev (PFS 16,5 vs 8,2 mo). Este FR intensifica para a pista de imunoterapia e sobrepõe-se ao algoritmo quimioterápico padrão do RAS/BRAF.
: MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement: : MYC + BCL2 (and/or BCL6) rearrangement (double-/triple-hit) confirmed by FISH — DA-EPOCH-R + IT methotrexate prophylaxis preferred over R-CHOP per multiple retrospective and small prospective series.
: MYD88 L265P is the hallmark mutation o: : MYD88 L265P é a mutação marcante da macroglobulinemia de Waldenström, presente em >90% da WM. Drives constitutiva NF-κB ativação através da BTK. iNOVATE (Dimopoulos NEJM 2018) e o seguimento a longo prazo iNOVATE estabelecido ibrutinib + rituximab > placebo + rituximab independentemente da terapêutica anterior; doença MYD88-L265P positiva tem a maior taxa de resposta à monoterapia com BTKi (ORR ~90%, resposta maior ~70%), enquanto MYD88-WT WM responde mal. Vias 1L sintomáticas WM com MYD88-L265P em direção à terapêutica baseada em BTKi (ibrutinib, zanubrutinib por ASPEN, ou ibrutinib + rituximab) em vez de quimioimuno da RDC quando é preferida a quimio-evitação (cardíaco, fragilidade, hiperviscosidade controlada).
: Mantle cell lymphoma with MIPI low ris: : Linfoma de células manteiras com baixo risco MIPI (MIPI <5,7 / 0-3 pontos simplificados) — suporta a indução padrão intensificada em doentes mais jovens (com base em Nórdico / R-DHAP) sem aumento adicional do tratamento
: Mantle cell lymphoma with blastoid / p: : Linfoma de células manteiras com morfologia blastoide / pleomórfica OR mutação TP53 OR del(17p) — variante agressiva resistente à quimioimunidade; rota diretamente para a terapia baseada em BTKi
: Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor prop: : Metastatic NSCLC with PD-L1 tumor proportion score (TPS) ≥50% by 22C3 IHC, no actionable driver mutations (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/BRAF/RET/MET/NTRK/ KRAS-G12C/HER2 wild-type or unselected). KEYNOTE-024 (Reck NEJM 2016; 5-year update Reck JCO 2021) established pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L over platinum-doublet chemo for TPS ≥50% (mOS 26.3 vs 13.4 mo, 5y OS 31.9% vs 16.3%). FDA-approved 2016. Atezolizumab (IMpower-110) and cemiplimab (EMPOWER-Lung-1) similarly approved. ESMO/NCCN 2024 prefer pembrolizumab monotherapy 1L for TPS ≥50% over chemo + IO combinations (KEYNOTE-189 / -407) when patient is fit and the TPS-50% determination is reliable.
: Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS: : Metastatic colorectal cancer with RAS wild-type status: KRAS exon 2 (codons 12, 13), exon 3 (codons 59, 61), exon 4 (codons 117, 146) AND NRAS exon 2/3/4 ALL wild-type by NGS or extended-RAS PCR. Defines the ~50% of mCRC eligible for anti-EGFR monoclonal antibody therapy (cetuximab, panitumumab) when combined with chemotherapy backbone. Left-sided RAS-WT mCRC particularly benefits from 1L anti-EGFR + FOLFOX/ FOLFIRI (CALGB/SWOG-80405, FIRE-3, PRIME, CRYSTAL — survival benefit driven by left-sided primaries; right-sided RAS-WT does NOT benefit and routes to bevacizumab + chemo).
: Multiple myeloma high-risk cytogenetic: : Citogenética de alto risco do mieloma múltiplo: qualquer das células t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), del(17p)/TP53 perda, ganho ou amplificação de 1q21 por FISH interfase em células plasmáticas CD138 enriquecidas
: NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion — pan-tumor acti: : NTRK1/2/3 gene fusion — pan-tumor actionable driver; <1% in NSCLC. Larotrectinib (NAVIGATE — ORR 75% pan-tumor) and entrectinib (STARTRK-2) are FDA tissue-agnostic TRK inhibitors. Treatment-defining if detected.
: Oligometastatic esophagogastric adenoc: : Oligometastático adenocarcinoma esofagogástrico por OMEC-1 (OligoMetastático Câncer Esofagogástrico) Consenso Europeu de Delfos (Kroese et al., Eur J Cancer 2023, PMID 36947929). Definido como ≤3 lesões metastáticas distantes susceptíveis de terapia local em um paciente com doença primária controlável e aptidão ECOG 0-1. Escenários excluídos: carcinomatose peritoneal, doença leptomeníngea, >3 metástases cerebrais. Ensaio RENAISSANCE / AIO-FLOT5 (NCT02578368) elegibilidade mais estreita: ≤1 envolvimento incurável do sistema orgânico, sem ascite, ≤1 estação retroperitoneal LN — utiliza quimioterapia FLOT ± ressecção cirúrgica (gastrectomia/esofagectomia + metástasectomia).
: PIK3CA hotspot activating mutation (E5: : A mutação activadora do hotspot PIK3CA (E542K, E545K, H1047R/L) na HR+/HER2- tumor de mama metastático — presente em ~40% dos casos. Após progressão no endócrino ± CDK4/6i, alpelisib + fulvestrant (SOLAR-1 — mPFS 11,0 vs 5,7 mo) ou capivasertib + fulvestrant (CAPItello-291 — mPFS 7,3 vs 3,1 mo) são opções direcionadas 2L+.
: PMF with anemia as dominant clinical p: : FPM com anemia como problema clínico dominante (Hb < 10 g/dL OR dependente de transfusão) — momelotinib preferido ao ruxolitinib (ensaio MOMIMENTUM: baço + sintoma + melhora da Hb)
: PV or ET high-risk for thrombosis: age: : PV ou ET de alto risco para trombose: idade > 60 OU trombose arterial / venosa prévia OR (apenas ET) JAK2 V617F + fatores de risco CV (IPSET-trombose alta) — desencadeia citorredução (HU 1L) além da flebotomia basal + ASA
: Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+: : Philadelphia-positive B-ALL (BCR-ABL1+) — TKI (imatinib/dasatinib/ponatinib) + chemotherapy is standard; Ph-like B-ALL signature requires JAK/ABL pathway-targeted addition.
: Platinum-sensitive ovarian relapse — P: : Recidiva ovárica sensível à platina — Intervalo livre de platina (PFI) > 6 meses da última dose de platina à recorrência. Definição do tratamento: re-platina duplot (carbo + paclitaxel/PLD/gem) ± manutenção bevacizumab. Manutenção PARPi após resposta se HRD-positiva.
: Post-CROSS-CRT-then-esophagectomy with: : Pós-CROSS-CRT-entonces-esofagectomia com doença residual — a patologia mostra ypT+ e/ou ypN+ (sem pCR). ~70% dos pacientes CROSS se inserem nesta categoria. Definição do tratamento: desloca o paciente para fora da via de resectabilidade-1L (CROSS neoadjuvante) para nivolumab adjuvante × 1 ano por CheckMate-577 (DFS 22 vs 11 mo placebo, HR 0,69). Janela de elegibilidade: iniciar em 4-16 semanas pós-operatório. Aplica-se tanto ao adenocarcinoma como à histologia das células escamosas.
: Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor: : Progression on covalent BTK inhibitor (ibrutinib, acalabrutinib, zanubrutinib). Triggers selection of non-covalent BTKi (pirtobrutinib), BCL2i (venetoclax-based regimens), CAR-T (lisocabtagene maraleucel, brexucabtagene autoleucel), or PI3Ki — depending on disease (CLL, MCL, WM). Resistance often driven by BTK C481S or PLCG2 mutation.
: RET fusion (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, othe: : fusão RET (KIF5B-RET, CCDC6-RET, outros) — ~1-2% de NSCLC adenocarcinoma. Selpercatinib (LIBRETTO-001 — ORR 85% TKI-naive) e pralsetinib (ARROW) são RET-TKIs selectivos aprovados pela FDA; preferido 1L em vez de multiquinase (cabo, vandetanib).
: ROS1 fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, othe: : ROS1 fusion (CD74-ROS1, EZR-ROS1, others) — ~1-2% of NSCLC adenocarcinoma; never-smoker enriched. Treatment-defining: entrectinib (CNS-active) or repotrectinib (TRIDENT-1, including post-crizotinib resistance) preferred 1L; crizotinib historic option.
: Rapid progression in CRC: relapse with: : Rapid progression in CRC: relapse within ≤6 months of completing adjuvant chemo (oxaliplatin-resistant phenotype), new peritoneal carcinomatosis with ascites + obstruction, OR rapid LDH/CEA doubling (>50% rise over 4-8 weeks). Alters 2L+ regimen choice + may contraindicate oxaliplatin re-introduction.
: Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prio: : Relapsed/refractory DLBCL post ≥2 prior systemic therapies, NOT a candidate for anti-CD19 CAR-T (axi-cel / liso-cel / tisa-cel) due to frailty, organ dysfunction, comorbidity burden, manufacturing-window risk, prior CAR-T failure, or absent funded referral pathway. Routes 3L+ to loncastuximab tesirine (LOTIS-2 Caimi 2021 Lancet Oncol; ORR 48%, CR 24%, mPFS 4.9 mo, mOS 9.5 mo) — off-the-shelf outpatient ADC ideally suited for non-CAR-T-eligible frail patient. Distinct from universal RF-CAR-T-INELIGIBLE-AGE-COMORBID (which gates on age ≥75 + Charlson ≥4) — this flag covers the broader DLBCL-specific ineligibility composite including UA access constraints (no funded international referral pathway).
: Resected stage III cutaneous melanoma: : Melanoma cutâneo de estágio III ressecado — biologia elegível para adjuvantes (biópsia positiva de linfócitos sentinelas ou doença nodal clinicamente detectada, ressecada cirurgicamente através de ampla excisão local ± completação de linfadenectomia ou dissecção terapêutica pescoço/inguinal por julgamento cirúrgico). Definição do tratamento: deslocar o doente da via metastática 1L para a imunoterapia adjuvante (KEYNOTE-054 pembrolizumab × 12 meses, CheckMate-238 nivolumab × 12 meses) ou adjuvante BRAFi+MEKi (COMBI-AD dabrafenib + trametinib) para mutantes BRAF V600. Terapia adjuvante iniciada no prazo de 12 semanas após a cirurgia definitiva nos ensaios de registo.
: Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicat: : Romidepsin inaccessible, contraindicated, or intolerant in AITL 2L+. Scenarios driving ineligibility: (1) Access — romidepsin is not approved in Ukraine (as of 2026); available only via named-patient programme or clinical trial; many patients cannot access; (2) Cardiac contraindication — class I/II QTc-prolonging cardiac arrhythmia or baseline QTc ≥480 ms; romidepsin HDACi class causes dose-dependent QTc prolongation and is contraindicated in significant baseline arrhythmia; (3) Prior HDACi intolerance — prior romidepsin or belinostat-related grade ≥3 cardiac event, thrombocytopenia, or GI toxicity requiring discontinuation. In all cases belinostat (BELIEF, 2014; PTCL ORR 25.8%, AITL ORR ~46%) is the preferred alternative HDACi: less QTc prolongation than romidepsin, IV weekly schedule, and UA-accessible via named-patient. Azacitidine remains an orthogonal alternative (HMA, not HDACi) routed via step 1 default.
: Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favour: : Shimoyama smoldering or chronic-favourable subtype of ATLL. Smoldering: ≥5% circulating abnormal lymphocytes, no organ involvement (skin/lung lesion permitted), LDH normal, BUN normal, albumin normal, no hypercalcemia, no lymphadenopathy or organomegaly. Chronic-favourable: similar to smoldering but lymphadenopathy/organomegaly permitted, LDH ≤2× ULN, BUN ≤ULN, albumin ≥ULN, Ca normal, no CNS/bone/GI/effusion. AZT+IFN-α (anti-HTLV-1 mechanism) yields 5-yr OS ~46% vs ~20% for chemotherapy in these subtypes (Bazarbachi 2010 meta-analysis, JNCI). Aggressive subtypes (acute/lymphoma/chronic-unfavourable) do NOT respond to AZT+IFN — route those to CHOEP+mogamulizumab via RF-ATLL-HIGH-RISK-BIOLOGY.
: Symptomatic CNS metastases — ICI doubl: : Metástases sintomáticas do SNC — ICI duplot (nivo+ipi) intracranianamente ativo; BRAFi+MEKi para crise visceral.
: T-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression ≥: : T-cell lymphoma with CD30 expression ≥10% by IHC — qualifies for brentuximab vedotin-based regimen (CHP-Bv per ECHELON-2)
: Treatment-defining biomarkers in metas: : Biomarcadores que definem o tratamento em adenocarcinoma gástrico/GEJ metastático: HER2+ (IHC 3+ OU 2+/ISH+) → trastuzumab+chemo TOGA / T-DXd 2L+; CLDN18.2+ (≥75% das células tumorais com 2+ coloração membranosa) → zolbetuximab+chemo SPOTLIGHT/GLOW; MSI-H → pembrolizumab mono; subtipo EBV+ (classe molecular TCG) — biologia distinta, ICI-favorável.
: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC):: : Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC): estrogen receptor (ER) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND progesterone receptor (PR) <1% nuclear staining on IHC AND HER2-negative (IHC 0 or 1+, OR IHC 2+ with ISH non-amplified). TNBC represents ~15-20% of all invasive breast cancers and is defined by the absence of all three hormone/growth-factor receptor targets. Clinical significance: TNBC lacks ER, PR, and HER2 targets, precluding endocrine therapy (tamoxifen, aromatase inhibitors) and HER2-directed therapy. Treatment is chemotherapy-based: - Early TNBC: pembrolizumab + neoadjuvant chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-522; Schmid NEJM 2022) — pCR rate 64.8% vs 51.2% with chemo alone, regardless of PD-L1 status. KEYNOTE-522 is the standard-of-care regimen. - Metastatic TNBC (BRCA-WT): pembrolizumab + chemotherapy (KEYNOTE-355) for CPS ≥10; chemotherapy alone (nab-paclitaxel, paclitaxel, or gemcitabine+carboplatin) for CPS <10. - Metastatic TNBC + germline BRCA1/2 mutation: olaparib or talazoparib preferred 1L over chemotherapy (OlympiAD; exploits HRD). Fires to route ALGO-BREAST-1L step 3 toward the TNBC track (step 4 stage gate → PARPi or pembro+chemo routing) instead of the HR+/HER2- track (CDK4/6i+AI, step 5). The engine sequential check (step 1: HER2+ gate via RF-BREAST-HER2-AMP- ACTIONABLE; step 3: TNBC gate via this RF) means HER2-positive patients are already routed away before step 3 fires. The HER2-negative component of the TNBC definition is therefore confirmed by the prior sequential filtering, but is included in the trigger for completeness and for use in non-sequential contexts.
: Visceral organ involvement (pulmonary,: : Envolvimento de órgãos viscerais (pulmonar, gastrointestinal ou outro local visceral) OU doença mucocutânea extensiva/rápidamente progressiva (lesões cutâneas generalizadas, linfedema associado ao tumor ou ulceração) no sarcoma de Kaposi de qualquer forma epidemiológica (aids- associada, iatrogênica, clássica ou endêmica). Não se espera que as doenças sintomáticas/extensas deste tipo sejam adequadamente controladas por restauração imunitária (TAR/ reequilíbrio imunossupressor) ou por terapêutica local isolada e conduz à quimioterapia sistêmica.
: Waldenström with clinical / biochemica: : Waldenström com características clínicas / bioquímicas relativas à transformação para DLBCL: elevação rápida da LDH, massa nodal ou extranodal assimétrica / rapidamente alargada, PET-CT SUVmax >10 (WM raramente PET-vídeo; SUV alto preocupante), B-sintomas em paciente previamente assintomático, ou hipercalcemia. Manda biópsia urgente excisional da lesão PET-vídeo.

ABC-06 trial established FOLFOX as 2L st: ABC-06 trial established FOLFOX as 2L standard (mOS 6.2 vs 5.3 mo active symptom control); however biliary drainage (ERCP / PTBD) is prerequisite — chemotherapy on uncontrolled cholangitis is associated with rapid sepsis. Peritoneal carcinomatosis indicates poor prognosis (mOS <6 mo); palliative intent and early hospice consultation appropriate.
ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no: ABSOLUTE FIRST-LINE for anaphylaxis — no equivalent alternative. H1/H2 antihistamines (diphenhydramine, famotidine), corticosteroids (hydrocortisone, methylprednisolone), and bronchodilators are all ADJUNCTS, NOT replacements. Delay or omission of epinephrine in anaphylaxis is the leading modifiable cause of fatal outcome — give EARLY (within 5 min of recognition), give IM thigh (NOT SC, NOT deltoid), and REPEAT every 5-15 min if symptoms persist. Common pitfall in chemotherapy infusion reactions: treating with diphenhydramine + steroid alone while withholding epinephrine for "mild" symptoms — escalate immediately if hypotension, bronchospasm, or upper airway involvement. Patients on β-blockers who develop refractory anaphylaxis: add glucagon 1-5 mg IV bolus then 5-15 µg/min infusion (bypasses β-receptor block via intracellular cAMP elevation). Auto-injectors not widely available in Ukraine — emergency department / oncology day-unit protocols should pre-position 1 mg/mL ampules + syringes and drill the IM-thigh administration. Ukraine: registered, NSZU- covered, ubiquitous.

ABVD = doxorubicin + bleomycin + vinblas: ABVD = doxorubicin + bleomycin + vinblastine + dacarbazine. In severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C, often from HL infiltration of liver / bulky abdominal disease compressing biliary tree), bleomycin (pulmonary toxicity additive risk; hepatic metabolism) and dacarbazine (significant hepatotoxicity; rare hepatic veno- occlusive syndrome) carry unacceptable risk. Modified AV (doxo + vinblastine only) preserves the two most active agents while removing the two with the worst hepatic / pulmonary safety in this setting. Reassess Child-Pugh weekly initially; reintroduce DTIC or bleomycin once bilirubin normalizes if HL response is partial. For newly-diagnosed advanced HL with severe hepatic dysfunction, brentuximab-AVD (BV + AVD; BV replaces bleomycin) is the better evidence-based choice if Bv accessible; AV is a second-line bridge when BV unavailable.

ELN 2022 favorable risk; standard 7+3 induction + 3-4 cycles HiDAC consolidation is curative-intent in CR1 (5-year OS 60-75%); upfront alloHCT is NOT recommended in CR1 default. Adding gemtuzumab ozogamicin to induction (ALFA-0701, AML-19) further improves OS specifically in CBF AML (HR 0.69). c-KIT mutations (D816, exon-8) co-occur in ~25% of CBF AML and may downgrade favorability — warrant MRD-directed approach.

MRD-positivity post-CR1 is the strongest single predictor of relapse (RFS hazard ratio 3-5×) and defines the population that benefits from consolidation intensification: alloHCT in CR1 (per ELN 2022) over standard HiDAC consolidation, or switch to MRD-directed maintenance (oral azacitidine post-consolidation per QUAZAR; gilteritinib post-alloHCT for FLT3-ITD per MORPHO).

APC (Adenomatous Polyposis Coli) is the: APC (Adenomatus Polyposis Coli) é o supressor de tumores do portador da via WNT/β-catenina. APC forma o complexo de destruição com AXIN1/2, GSK-3β e CK1α que fosforila a β-catenina (CTNNB1) em resíduos de exon 3 (S33/S37/T41/S45) visando a degradação proteassômica. Perda de APC → β-catenina acumula, transloca ao núcleo, ativa transcrição TCF/LEF de MYC, CCND1, e genes pró-pro- proliferativos. Frequência: mutação somática APC em ~80% do CRC esporádico (acontecimento mais precoce na sequência de adenoma-carcinoma). Germlina: FAP (polipose adenomatosa familiar) — >100 adenomas, quase 100% de risco de CRC por 40y sem colectomia; AFAP (FAP atenuado) — menor número de adenomas, início posterior. Relevância clínica: A mutação APC é um contexto diagnóstico/prognóstico no CRC; nenhuma terapia direcionada APC aprovada. Subrogação: a β-catenina nuclear por IHC confirma a ativação da via WNT quando a sequenciação não está disponível.

APC somatic loss-of-function mutations occur in ~80% of sporadic colorectal carcinomas (CRC) and represent the earliest molecular event in the adenoma-carcinoma sequence. APC loss stabilizes β-catenin, driving constitutive WNT target gene transcription (MYC, CCND1). Despite its ubiquity, APC is not a direct therapeutic target for systemic therapy in CRC: (1) WNT pathway inhibitors: porcupine inhibitors (WNT-974/LGK-974, RXC004) block Wnt ligand secretion upstream of APC and are in Phase I/II trials across WNT-driven tumors including CRC. Early results show modest single-agent activity; no CRC-specific approval. (2) Tankyrase inhibitors: block AXIN degradation → restore destruction complex despite APC loss; early preclinical/Phase I (NVP-TNKS656, G007-LK); dose-limiting GI toxicity. (3) APC loss does not predict response to anti-EGFR (cetuximab/panitumumab) in CRC — RAS/RAF wild-type status determines anti-EGFR eligibility, not APC status. (4) MSI-H/dMMR CRC (~15%) frequently co-occurs with somatic APC mutation; immunotherapy (pembrolizumab 1L or 2L) is actionable via the MMR deficie...

AR (androgen receptor) gene amplification detected on tumor or ctDNA NGS in mCRPC — INFORMATIONAL signal of mechanistic ARSI resistance. AR amplification is one of the most common acquired resistance mechanisms to abiraterone / enzalutamide / apalutamide / darolutamide; detected in ~30-50% of post-ARSI mCRPC ctDNA samples. AR-amp argues against ARSI-after-ARSI sequencing (limited cross-class benefit) and for early switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 (if PSMA-PET-positive). FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-amp status — surfaces in MDT brief to flag patients in whom further ARSI escalation is unlikely to add benefit. Companion to RF-PROSTATE-AR-V7-ARSI-RESISTANCE (AR-V7 splice variant); both detect distinct facets of AR-driven resistance.

AR amplification is one of three dominan: AR amplification is one of three dominant AR-pathway-driven ARSI-resistance mechanisms in mCRPC (alongside AR-V7 splice variant and AR ligand-binding- domain mutations). High-level AR-amp (ctDNA CN ≥2.5 by Guardant360, or tissue NGS CN ≥4) is detectable in 30-50% of mCRPC progressing on abiraterone or enzalutamide and correlates with shorter PFS/OS on continued ARSI. Distinct from AR-V7 (splice variant — see BIO-AR-V7): AR-amp = wild-type-AR overexpression (still ligand-binding-domain competent; can still respond to higher-affinity ARSI in some cases), AR-V7 = constitutively-active LBD-truncated isoform (ligand-independent, ARSI cannot bind). Clinical use: ctDNA AR-CN trajectory under ARSI monitors clonal selection; rising AR-CN signals impending progression. HOWEVER: NO FDA-approved Tx decision keyed on AR-amp; guidelines (NCCN, ESMO, EAU) treat it as informational / prognostic. Use in MDT brief to flag patients at risk of ARSI-resistance and to discuss switch to taxane (docetaxel, cabazitaxel), 177Lu-PSMA-617 (PSMA-positive), or PARPi (HRR-mutated). AR-V7 detection by itself is sufficient: AR-V7 detection by itself is sufficient to skip an HRR panel because resistance to ARPIs is then certain.
AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice: AR-V7 is a constitutively-active splice variant of the androgen receptor lacking the ligand-binding domain. Detected most commonly on circulating tumor cells (CTCs) by Epic AR-V7 Nucleus Detect IHC. Clinical relevance in mCRPC: AR-V7-positive patients have markedly inferior PFS/OS on abiraterone or enzalutamide compared to AR-V7-negative (PROPHECY, Antonarakis 2019, J Clin Oncol — HR ~3 for inferior survival). Switch to taxane chemotherapy (docetaxel, cabazitaxel) recovers responses. HOWEVER: FDA has NOT approved any therapy decision keyed on AR-V7; guidelines treat it as investigational / informational. Use in MDT brief to flag patients in whom ARSI-after-ARSI is unlikely to work and for whom a switch to taxane (or radioligand 177Lu-PSMA-617 if PSMA-positive) should be discussed. KB scope choice: AR-V7 ships as biomarker + RF (informational) only — no new IND, no algorithm step in this chunk. Tx-modifying signal ("switch ARSI → taxane") would require a new taxane-mCRPC IND branched on AR-V7, which is deferred.

ARASENS: significant OS benefit for trip: ARASENS: significant OS benefit for triplet vs ADT + docetaxel in high-volume mHSPC. Requires docetaxel-eligible patient (ECOG 0-1, no significant comorbidity). UA-access constrained by darolutamide reimbursement gap — flagged for clinical-review queue.
ARIEL3 (recurrent platinum-sensitive mai: ARIEL3 (recurrent platinum-sensitive maintenance after CR/PR to most recent platinum, ≥2 prior platinum lines): BRCA-mut mPFS 16.6 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.23); HRD+ 13.6 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.32); all-comers 10.8 vs 5.4 mo (HR 0.36). Third PARPi maintenance option after olaparib (SOLO-2) and niraparib (NOVA). Distinct AE: ALT/AST elevation common but usually transient; non-progressive creatinine elevation (transporter effect) is not nephrotoxicity.

AXIN2 germline pathogenic variants cause: AXIN2 germline pathogenic variants cause a Lynch-like attenuated polyposis + oligodontia syndrome (Lammi et al. 2004) — characterized by congenital absence of multiple permanent teeth (oligodontia, often >6 teeth), early- onset adenomas, attenuated polyposis (typically <100 adenomas), and elevated colorectal cancer risk. AXIN2 is a WNT-pathway tumor suppressor; loss stabilizes β-catenin. Confirmed-carrier surveillance protocol follows attenuated FAP / Lynch-like template: colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 25 (or 10y before earliest family CRC), with polypectomy of all detected adenomas; if adenoma burden grows beyond endoscopic management, surgical consultation. Cascade testing to first-degree relatives. Oligodontia is a useful clinical flag — dental record review may identify undiagnosed carriers. ESCAT IIA.

A mutação adquirida do EGFR T790M (gatekeeper) na progressão do EGFR-TKI de 1o/2o-Gênero (gefitinib, erlotinib, afatinib, dacomitinib) — impulsiona a mudança de 2L para o osimertinib (AURA3 — mPFS 10,1 vs 4,4 mo com pem-platina). Detetado no NGS ctDNA ou rebiopsia de tecidos.
Acquired in ~30–40% of HR+ HER2− metasta: Adquirido em ~30–40% da HR+ HER2− progressão metastática da mama no inibidor da aromatase; <1% em tumores primários no diagnóstico. Previsivo para elacestrant (ensaio oral SERD; EMERALD — benefício da PFS limitado ao subgrupo ESR1-mut). Teste sobre o ctDNA na progressão na IA ± CDK4/6i. Outros SERDs orais (camizestrant, giredestrant, imunestrant) e PROTACs no desenvolvimento tardio. Y537S confere biologia mais agressiva do que D538G em algumas séries. ctDNA é o espécime preferido porque mutações ESR1 são tipicamente subclonais em tecido e frequentemente policlonais em locais metastáticos.
Acquired in ~50-60% of patients progress: Acquired in ~50-60% of patients progressing on 1st/2nd-generation EGFR-TKI. Per AURA3 (Mok 2017), osimertinib doubles PFS vs platinum/ pemetrexed in T790M+. May also occur de novo (rare; ~1%) — typically germline. ctDNA "liquid biopsy" first-line per NCCN at acquired resistance, with tissue confirmation if negative.
Acquired resistance mutation to 3rd-gene: Acquired resistance mutation to 3rd-generation EGFR-TKI (osimertinib) — the C797 cysteine is the covalent-binding residue for osimertinib, so C797S abolishes irreversible inhibition. Most common osimertinib- resistance EGFR-on-target alteration (~7-22% of post-osimertinib re-biopsies). Triggers ESCAT IB pathway: amivantamab + lazertinib per MARIPOSA-2 (Passaro 2024). Cis vs trans T790M+C797S configuration matters: trans (different alleles) may respond to combo of 3rd-gen + 1st/2nd-gen EGFR-TKI; cis (same allele) is fully resistant to all current EGFR-TKI monotherapy and requires bypass strategy (amivantamab-based, chemo, or trial enrollment).
Acquired resistance to 1st-gen TRK inhib: Acquired resistance to 1st-gen TRK inhibitors typically emerges via on-target kinase-domain mutations (G595R for NTRK1, G623R for NTRK3, solvent-front and gatekeeper variants) within 12-24 months; off-target bypass via MAPK signaling described. Selitrectinib (LOXO-195) and repotrectinib (TPX-0005) are 2nd-gen designed to overcome these mutations — TRIDENT-1 enrolled pediatric with promising responses in TRK-resistant. Salvage cytotoxic (VAC, Ewing-like VDC/IE) reasonable if 2nd-gen unavailable. Re-biopsy at progression strongly recommended.
Acquired resistance to dabrafenib + tram: Resistência adquirida ao dabrafenib + trametinib no ATC mutante BRAF (reativação secundária BRAF / MEK / RAS / MAPK, mutações NRAS ou KRAS, amplificação BRAF), progressão local rápida na TRC citotóxica, novas metástases distantes (pulmão, osso, cérebro), ou transformação do cancro diferenciado da tireóide (DTC) em componente ATC (evento de desdiferenciação) — desencadeia a reestadia, a rebiopsia, a imunoterapia de resgate (pembrolizumab ou pembrolizumab + lenvatinib) ou a inscrição no ensaio.

Síndrome carcinoide ativa em um paciente com GI-NET metastático ou irresecável (ou outro NET de secretação de serotonina). Definida clinicamente por qualquer uma das: rubor episódico, diarreia secretaria (≥4 fezes soltas/dia), broncoconstrição urinária elevada 24 horas 5-HIAA/sérico serotonina. Síndrome carcinoide requer terapia SSA para controle de sintomas independentemente da intenção antiproliferativa; SSA é também o padrão antiproliferativo (CLARINET, PROMID).
Active in pre-chemotherapy and post-doce: Ativo na pré- quimioterapia e pós-docetaxel MCRPC. CNS penetração > apalutamide / darolutamide; EAs cognitivas mais comuns em idosos.
Active infection at diagnosis is common: Active infection at diagnosis is common in HCL (severe neutropenia from disease itself). Standard practice: control infection first (G-CSF + antibiotics), then start cladribine. Hold-direction surfaces in MDT brief but doesn't shift Indication.
Active or latent HBV without antiviral p: Active or latent HBV without antiviral prophylaxis is an absolute contraindication to starting B-cell-depleting / immunomodulatory monoclonal antibody therapy (anti-CD20, anti-CD30 ADC, anti-CD38). Severe HBV reactivation hepatitis risk including fulminant hepatic failure.

Active tobacco smoking (current smoker OR cessation <15 years) OR smokeless tobacco use OR significant secondhand smoke exposure. IARC Group 1 carcinogen — established etiological driver of lung cancer (NSCLC + SCLC; population-attributable fraction ~80-90%), urothelial bladder cancer, head + neck squamous cell carcinoma, oropharyngeal, laryngeal, esophageal SCC, pancreatic cancer, kidney (RCC), cervical, acute myeloid leukemia (component cause), and others (~20 cancer types per US Surgeon General reports). Tobacco cessation is the single highest-impact modifiable cancer-risk-factor intervention. Prevention- persona RedFlag (§20 v0.3 lifestyle pilot).

Re-biopsy at progression captures actionable molecular drivers in ~30-40% (HER2, AR, NTRK, HRAS, NOTCH1) — changes salvage choice from cytotoxic to targeted. Skull-base extension may benefit from proton-beam RT (improves organ-at-risk sparing).

Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressiv: Adrenocortical carcinoma is an aggressive rare cancer of the adrenal cortex. Bimodal age distribution (pediatric and adult peaks) reflects two distinct biological contexts: pediatric ACC is overwhelmingly hereditary (Li-Fraumeni / Beckwith-Wiedemann), adult ACC is mostly sporadic with ~10% hereditary component. Functional ACC presents with hormonal syndromes: hypercortisolism (Cushing — most common, ~50% of functional ACC), virilization (androgen-secreting; especially in women), feminization (estrogen- secreting; rare; in men), Conn syndrome (aldosterone-secreting; rare). Non-functional ACC presents with mass effect, abdominal pain, or as incidental imaging finding. Staging: ENSAT (European Network for the Study of Adrenal Tumors) staging system; tumor size >6 cm, capsular invasion, regional nodes, distant metastasis are key prognostic factors. Mitotic count (Weiss score / Helsinki score) drives recurrence-risk stratification. Treatment fundamentals (full Indications pending): radical adrenalectomy with curative intent for resectable disease — open approach historically preferred (laparoscopic associated with positive-margin / peritoneal-seeding risk in retrospective series). Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the: Adult GCT is defined molecularly by the FOXL2 p.C134W mutation (present in ~97% of cases), which is the only pathognomonic molecular alteration in any solid tumor. FOXL2 is a granulosa cell transcription factor; the C134W mutation is a dominant-negative gain-of-function that prevents normal granulosa cell differentiation. Clinically, tumors present with estrogen excess (abnormal uterine bleeding, endometrial pathology) or abdominal mass. Prognosis is generally favorable for stage I (90% 10-yr OS) but late recurrences (10–20 years) are characteristic. No FDA-approved targeted therapy as of 2026; FOXL2 inhibition and CDK4/6 inhibitors are in clinical trials. FOXL2 mutation testing is diagnostic, not therapeutic selection (ESCAT IIB — clinical utility as diagnostic/prognostic marker).

CheckMate-649 (Janjigian Lancet 2021; final OS 2024) established nivolumab + chemo (FOLFOX or XELOX) over chemo alone for CPS ≥5 (mOS 14.4 vs 11.1 mo, HR 0.71) with continued benefit at CPS ≥1 (HR 0.78). FDA approved nivolumab + chemo for HER2-negative gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma 1L regardless of CPS; EMA restricts to CPS ≥5. NCCN/ESMO 2024 favor adding nivolumab to FOLFOX/XELOX for CPS ≥1 (with stronger preference at CPS ≥5).

After progression on THP the canonical 2: After progression on THP the canonical 2L option in the OpenOnco model is trastuzumab deruxtecan (DESTINY-Breast03). Patients with active CNS metastases — particularly progression after IO/HER2-directed therapy — pull tucatinib + trastuzumab + capecitabine into the conversation because the HER2CLIMB trial demonstrated CNS activity. Germline BRCA1/2 status brings PARP-inhibitor reasoning into the longer sequencing arc but does not displace the HER2-directed backbone at any line.
After progression on the first mCRPC lin: Após a progressão na primeira linha do mCRPC, o capítulo espera que o aprendiz pese cabazitaxel, Lu-177-PSMA e rádio-223 uns contra os outros. CARD estabeleceu cabazitaxel após exposição sequencial ARPI + docetaxel. Lu-177-PSMA requer doença positiva PSMA-PET e exposição prévia taxano / ARPI por VISÃO. Radium-223 é reservado para doença sintomática predominante óssea sem metástases viscerais (ALSYMPCA). O modelo OpenOnco superfícies todas as três como opções paralelas e usa bandeiras vermelhas (carga visceral, transformação, reserva de medula) para restringir a escolha.
After response to platinum, OpenOnco rou: After response to platinum, OpenOnco routes maintenance choices by combined BRCA / HRD status. BRCA-mutant disease (germline or somatic) routes to olaparib maintenance as the canonical first option (SOLO-1). HRD-positive non-BRCA disease pulls niraparib (PRIMA) and olaparib combinations into the conversation, often with bevacizumab continued from induction. HRD-negative disease without BRCA mutation typically relies on bevacizumab maintenance or observation; the chapter is explicit that adding a PARP inhibitor to HRD-negative non-BRCA disease is not the canonical default.

PiZZ confers elevated HCC risk in cirrhotic subset (~3-5%/year in adult cirrhotic A1AT-deficient cohorts; Pittelkow et al. JAMA 2014; Tanash et al. Gastroenterology 2016) and elevated lung cancer risk in smokers + non-smokers (Pittelkow JAMA 2014; observational cohorts SIR ~2-3 for lung cancer, multiplicatively higher with smoking). Among the most lethal solid tumors histo: Among the most lethal solid tumors historically — IVC by AJCC at diagnosis (any T any N M0/M1 = stage IVA/B/C). Median OS without targeted therapy 3-6 months; rapid airway compromise common. Time-critical workup: BRAF V600E status drives first-line systemic therapy and must be available within days, not weeks. ATA 2021 guideline mandates rapid IHC (VE1 antibody) + reflex sequencing. Therapy by genotype: - BRAF V600E mutant (~25–40%): dabrafenib + trametinib (ROAR basket trial — ORR ~56%, transformative); FDA approved 2018 for ATC. Often used as neoadjuvant induction → surgery → adjuvant chemoRT. - BRAF wild-type RAS / NTRK / RET targetable: selpercatinib / pralsetinib / larotrectinib / entrectinib per genotype. - BRAF/RAS/NTRK/RET wild-type: chemo-radiation (paclitaxel + RT or docetaxel + doxorubicin + RT); pembrolizumab if PD-L1+ or TMB-H. Tracheostomy decision is patient-/family-driven; some protocols defer to systemic-therapy response over upfront tracheostomy when BRAF-mutant.

A hormona anti-mülleriana (AMH) reflete o tamanho do pool folículo primordial e é o melhor biomarcador único da reserva ovárica. Na população portadora de BRCA1/2, a AMH é usada como DECISÃO-APOIO para a redução do risco de salpingooforectomia (RSSO/BSO) timing, aconselhamento de fertilidade e planejamento de criopreservação de oócitos — NÃO como teste de triagem para o câncer de ovário. NCCN Genetic/Familial Mama/Ovarian 2025 recomenda BSO aos 35-40 anos (BRCA1) / 40-45 (BRCA2) após a conclusão da gravidez. A AMH é uma entrada que informa o custo/benefício personalizado da criopreservação pré-BSO de oócitos e das decisões pós-BSO de reposição de hormonas menopausais. A AMH NÃO prevê o risco de câncer de ovário e NÃO substitui a recomendação de BSO germinal-driven-mutation. ESCAT X — A AMH não conduz a seleção do tratamento do câncer; categorizado como suporte reprodutivo-conselheira.

Authored as a separate disease from ET (: Autorizado como uma doença separada da ET (em vez de uma única YAML combinada PV-ET). Racionalidade (por mensagem de commit de expansão mielóide): JAK2 V617F a prevalência é essencialmente universal no PV (~95%) mas apenas ~50% no ET; os fatores de risco trombóticos diferem (Hct + massa RBC em PV vs contagem de plaquetas + JAK2 + idade em ET); 1L a participação na citorredução HU, mas PV adiciona flebotomia obrigatória + baixa dose de ASA basal E ruxolitinib tem uma indicação de PV (RESPONSE) distinta do MF. ET YAML reutiliza RFs sobrepostos, mas tem seu próprio algoritmo. STUB — requer sinal de co-lead clínico antes da publicação. Expansão mielóide (heme).
Authored as composite (vs three separate: Autorizado como composto (vs três biomarcadores separados) por pedaço de esquema-readout: NCCN ordena estes no mesmo painel hereditário e os reporta juntos; 1:1:1 dividir criaria três arquivos quase idênticos. Se as regras a jusante necessitam de comportamento específico do gene (provavelmente para CDK12, cuja biologia diverge), dividir esta entrada em seguida — o composto é um agrupamento v0.1, não uma decisão permanente. Authored as separate disease from PV (se: Authored as separate disease from PV (see DIS-PV.notes for rationale). Treatment: low-risk ET → ASA only (avoid in extreme thrombocytosis with acquired vWD); high-risk → HU 1L; anagrelide 2L (PT-1 trial — non-inferior on thrombosis but more arterial events + bleeding + MF progression). PreT-PMF ("prefibrotic primary myelofibrosis") is increasingly distinguished from ET on trephine — has worse prognosis and behaves more like PMF; current scope: standard ET only. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff before publication. Myeloid expansion (heme).

Autologous T cells genetically modified: Autologous T cells genetically modified ex vivo with lentiviral vector encoding chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19, with 4-1BB costimulatory domain (CD137) and CD3-zeta signaling domain. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, single IV infusion → in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against CD19+ B-cell malignancies. Approved for R/R B-ALL ≤25 years (ELIANA) and R/R DLBCL adult (JULIET).
Autologous T cells transduced with a len: Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a CAR with anti-CD19 single-chain variable fragment (FMC63), 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and CD3-zeta activation domain. Distinguishing feature is administration of a defined 1:1 ratio of CD4+ and CD8+ CAR-T cells (separately manufactured, then combined), which is hypothesized to deliver more predictable expansion kinetics and a more favorable CRS/ICANS profile vs CD28-based products. Lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning precedes a single IV infusion. Approved by FDA Feb 2021 and EMA April 2022 for relapsed/ refractory large B-cell lymphoma (TRANSCEND-NHL-001), expanded in 2022 to 2L (TRANSFORM trial), and in 2024 to relapsed/refractory CLL/SLL (TRANSCEND-CLL-004) and to relapsed/refractory follicular lymphoma (TRANSCEND-FL).

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) containing a murine anti-BCMA single-chain variable fragment (scFv), a CD8α hinge/ transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3- zeta activation domain. Recognizes B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo CAR-T expansion, peak ~7-11 days post-infusion, with sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. First CAR-T therapy approved for multiple myeloma (FDA Mar 2021, KarMMa). Expanded to 2L+ R/R MM (KarMMa-3) in 2024 for triple-class-exposed patients.

Autologous T cells transduced with a lentiviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) that contains two BCMA-targeting heavy-chain-only variable domains (VHH) in tandem, a CD8α hinge/transmembrane region, a 4-1BB costimulatory domain, and a CD3-zeta activation domain. The bivalent VHH design improves avidity for B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA), expressed on malignant plasma cells. After lymphodepleting fludarabine + cyclophosphamide conditioning, a single IV infusion produces in vivo expansion + sustained cytotoxicity against BCMA+ myeloma cells. Approved by FDA Feb 2022 and EMA May 2022 for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma after ≥4 prior lines (CARTITUDE-1) and expanded in 2024 to 2L+ R/R MM in lenalidomide-refractory patients (CARTITUDE-4).
Autologous T-cells engineered with anti-: Células T autólogos fabricadas com anti-CD19 CAR (CD28 costim + CD3-zeta activação, construto receptor idêntico a axi-cel) mas fabricadas com uma fase de depleção de CD19 antes da transdução — reduz a contaminação de células B CD19+ malignas do produto da aférese (clínicamente significativa na LCM leucêmica onde as células malignas circulantes são proeminentes). Após o condicionamento linfoagoria, as células projetadas expandem-se in vivo, reconhecem as células B CD19+, desencadeiam a morte citotóxica.
Autologous T-cells transduced with retro: Autologous T-cells transduced with retroviral vector encoding a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting CD19 with CD28 costimulatory + CD3-zeta activation domains. Following lymphodepleting conditioning (fludarabine + cyclophosphamide), engineered cells expand in vivo, recognize CD19+ B-cells (malignant + normal), trigger cytotoxic killing + cytokine release. Single infusion; persistence weeks to months.

BAP1 (BRCA1-associated protein 1) is a n: BAP1 (BRCA1-associated protein 1) is a nuclear deubiquitinase / tumor suppressor on 3p21. Somatic loss is a major prognostic and lineage- defining lesion in two rare tumors: **Uveal melanoma (UM):** - BAP1 LOF (somatic, often biallelic via 3p loss + somatic mutation) is the dominant driver of metastatic risk. - Class 2 GEP / BAP1-loss UM: ~70-80% metastasize within 5 years (vs <10% for BAP1-retained class 1). Liver-tropic metastatic pattern. - Distinct from cutaneous melanoma: GNAQ/GNA11 are the activating drivers; BAP1 is the metastatic-risk modifier. - Tebentafusp (gp100 × CD3 ImmTAC, FDA-approved 2022 for HLA-A*02:01+ metastatic UM) is the first systemic OS-prolonging therapy; BAP1 status does not currently gate eligibility but is standard prognostic stratification. **Malignant pleural / peritoneal mesothelioma:** - BAP1 LOF in ~50-60% of mesotheliomas, frequently as part of germline BAP1 tumor predisposition syndrome (TPDS) — increased lifetime risk of mesothelioma, uveal melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, cutaneous melanocytic BAP1-inactivated tumors. - BAP1 IHC loss is part of the WHO 2021 mesothelioma diagnostic criteria (with MTAP IHC + CDKN2A FISH). - Pre-clinical: BAP1-defi...

BLM germline biallelic pathogenic variants cause Bloom syndrome — autosomal-recessive disorder of replication-fork resolution (BLM RecQ helicase loss). Phenotype: severe pre- and postnatal growth restriction, characteristic facial features + sun-sensitive erythematous facial rash (telangiectatic), immunodeficiency, diabetes, and very high lifetime cancer risk with broad spectrum: leukemia (AML, ALL), lymphoma, early colorectal + gastric + skin (BCC, SCC, melanoma) + breast + GU cancers. Median age at first cancer diagnosis ~25 years; many patients develop multiple primary cancers. Confirmed-carrier (biallelic) surveillance protocol (per Bloom Syndrome Registry / Cunniff et al. 2017): strict sun protection from infancy; annual dermatology + comprehensive skin exam; complete blood count q3-6mo (leukemia surveillance); colonoscopy q1-2y starting age 12-15 with polypectomy; EGD q1-2y from age 12-15; breast MRI + mammography annual from age 18-20 in women; symptom-directed evaluation with low threshold (cancers present atypically and at all ages). Avoid ionizing radiation when possible — radiosensitivity is documented. Monoallelic (heterozygous) BLM carriers may have modestly elevated cancer risk (Ashkenazi BLM-Ash founder variant — small CRC association in some studies); standard-population screening reasonable. ESCAT IIA (biallelic carriers).

BRAF V600E/K-mutant disease pulls dabraf: BRAF V600E/K-mutant disease pulls dabrafenib + trametinib or encorafenib + binimetinib into the canonical first-line conversation. The OpenOnco model uses targeted therapy first when rapid response is needed (high tumor burden, symptomatic disease, organ-threatening progression) or when IO is contraindicated (active uncontrolled autoimmune disease, recent organ transplantation, severe baseline immune dysfunction). The default in BRAF-mutant disease without these features remains IO first because durable IO responses outperform the duration of targeted-therapy benefit in most prospective evidence.

Barrett's esophagus (intestinal metaplasia of the distal esophagus with goblet cells on biopsy after EGD performed for chronic GERD or Barrett's-specific surveillance) in an individual without a current esophageal adenocarcinoma diagnosis. Established precursor lesion to esophageal adenocarcinoma — annual progression rates: non-dysplastic Barrett's ~0.1-0.3%/year to EAC, low-grade dysplasia (LGD) ~0.7-2%/year, high-grade dysplasia (HGD) ~7-19%/year. Endoscopic surveillance and endoscopic eradication therapy (radiofrequency ablation, endoscopic mucosal resection) for dysplastic Barrett's substantially reduce EAC incidence and mortality. Prevention-persona RedFlag (§20 ratification 2026-05-18, v0.3 chronic-condition pilot).

Bibliographic record SRC-EPCORE-NHL-1-TH: Bibliographic record SRC-EPCORE-NHL-1-THIEBLEMONT-2023 is available; clinical claim linkage requires dual clinical sign-off. Efficacy figures cited inline reflect Thieblemont et al. J Clin Oncol 2023 41(12):2238-2247 (DOI 10.1200/JCO.22.01725). Step-up schedule: cycle 1 days 1/8/15 priming (0.16 mg → 0.8 mg → 48 mg) to mitigate CRS; full dose 48 mg SC weekly cycles 1-3, biweekly cycles 4-9, q4w cycle 10+. CRS ~50% any grade / 2.5% G3+ (mostly cycle 1); ICANS ~6% / <1% G3+. Infection G3+ ~15%; tocilizumab + dexamethasone for CRS. Sequencing post-CAR-T: epcoritamab retains activity (cohort 1B EPCORE NHL-1 ~54% ORR post-CAR-T). NOT to be used in CD20-negative escape variants — re-biopsy if late-relapse. STUB — requires clinical co-lead signoff.
Bibliographic record SRC-NP30179-DICKINS: Registro bibliográfico SRC-NP30179-DICKINSON-2022 está disponível; a ligação clínica requer dupla assinatura clínica. Os valores de eficácia citados em linha refletem Dickinson et al. NEJM 2022 387(24):2220-2231 (DOI 10.1056/NEJMoa2206913). Horário: obinutuzumab 1000 mg IV pré-tratamento dia -7; intensificação C1D8 2,5 mg, C1D15 10 mg, C2D1 30 mg, em seguida 30 mg q3w ciclos 2-12 (fixado 12 ciclos totais). CRS ~63% qualquer grau / 4% G3+ (ciclo concentrado 1); ICANS ~8% / ~3% G3+. Tocilizumab + corticosteróide para CRS. Sequenciamento: a atividade do glofitamab pós-CAR-T preservada; dados pós-BiTE (epcoritamab) emergentes. A duração fixa é operacionalmente mais simples do que a dosagem contínua do SC para configurações de baixo recurso. NÃO deve ser usada em variantes de fuga CD20 negativas — re-biopsia se tardia-recidiva. STUB — requer sinal de co-líder clínico.

Bifunctional alkylating agent of the nit: Bifunctional alkylating agent of the nitrogen-mustard class. Aromatic nitrogen mustard with a phenylbutyric-acid carrier; less reactive (and therefore better orally bioavailable + less acutely toxic) than classical nitrogen mustards. Forms aziridinium intermediates that alkylate the N7 position of guanine, generating intra- and interstrand DNA cross-links → blocked replication, transcription, and apoptosis (preferentially in slowly-dividing lymphoid cells). Cell-cycle non-specific. Used for decades in CLL (now largely supplanted by BTK and BCL2 inhibitors), Waldenström, and as the partner of obinutuzumab in elderly comorbid CLL (CLL11 trial).
Bifunctional alkylating agent with a pur: Agente alquilante bifuncional com uma fração de benzimidazol parecida com a purina; induz dano ao DNA e apoptose em linfócitos.
Biktarvy is a preferred first-line singl: Biktarvy é um regime de ART de primeira linha de um único comprimido preferido por DHHS / EACS / NIH AIDSinfo diretrizes (2024). Combina bittegravir (inibidor da transferência de fita de integração), emtricitabina (NRTI), tenofovir-AF (NRTI). Alta barreira genética à resistência, interações medicamentosas mínimas bem toleradas vs. regimes baseados em IP mais antigos. Recomendado para via de prevenção do HIV-Câncer (por IND-CHRONIC-HIV-PREVENTION-ART). Triagem de interação medicamentosa obrigatória antes de qualquer tratamento do câncer é adicionado.

Binds CD38, which is highly expressed on: Binds CD38, which is highly expressed on plasma cells. Induces myeloma cell death through complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC), antibody- dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP), apoptosis, and immunomodulation via depletion of CD38+ regulatory T-cells.
Binds HER2 subdomain II, blocking HER2:H: Liga o subdomínio HER2 II, bloqueando a heterodimerização HER2:HER3 — mecanismo complementar ao trastuzumab (que liga o subdomínio IV). Combinação de duplo bloqueio é sinérgica.
Binds PML moiety of PML-RARα fusion → SU: Liga a parte PML da fusão PML-RARα → SUMOilação, ubiquitinação e degradação proteassômica da oncoproteína. Sinergiza com ATRA. Com ATRA, faz da APL a primeira leucemia aguda curada em quimioterapia.
Binds a distinct, allosteric epitope on: Binds a distinct, allosteric epitope on CD38 (different from daratumumab's binding site) on plasma cells and other CD38+ populations. Induces myeloma cell death through complement-dependent cytotoxicity (CDC), antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity (ADCC), antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis (ADCP), direct apoptosis (Fc-independent — distinguishes from daratumumab), and immunomodulation via depletion of CD38+ regulatory T-cells and inhibition of CD38 enzymatic activity (NAD+/cADPR axis). Cross- reactivity with daratumumab is partial — clinical activity has been observed after daratumumab failure in some patients but the two agents are treated as the same effective class for sequencing purposes (one-shot anti-CD38 line per CHARTER hierarchy).
Binds cereblon (CRBN) within the CRL4-CR: Binds cereblon (CRBN) dentro do complexo CRL4-CRBN E3 ubiquitina ligase, redirecionando-o para o ubiquitinado IKZF1 e IKZF3 fatores de transcrição. Sua degradação é seletivamente citotóxica para células de mieloma múltiplo e tem efeitos imunomoduladores (ativação NK e T-células).
Binds hydroxyapatite in bone matrix; inh: Liga a hidroxiapatita na matriz óssea; inibe a osteoclasto farnesil pirofosfato sintase, interrompendo a via mevalonada e induzindo a apoptose osteoclasto. Reduz eventos relacionados com o esqueleto na doença óssea mieloma.
Binds retinoic-acid receptor α (RARα) an: Liga o receptor retinoico-ácido α (RARα) e degrada a oncoproteína de fusão PML-RARα na APL → força a diferenciação blástica em vez de matar.
Binds the benzodiazepine site on GABA-A: Binds the benzodiazepine site on GABA-A receptors, increasing the frequency of chloride channel opening upon GABA binding and producing hyperpolarization of neurons in cortical, limbic, and brainstem pathways. Therapeutic effects in oncology supportive care: anticipatory chemotherapy-induced nausea/vomiting (CINV) — where conditioned anxiety triggers nausea before chemo administration — and management of acute anxiety, insomnia, and agitation in hospitalized cancer patients. Also used as an anticonvulsant for seizure rescue (high-dose chemotherapy, ifosfamide encephalopathy, CNS metastases) and as an adjunct to multi-receptor antiemetic regimens for refractory CINV. Approved by FDA September 1977.
Binds the glucocorticoid receptor; in my: Liga o receptor glucocorticoide; em células mieloma induz a apoptose através da supressão da sinalização NF-κB e efeitos diretos nas vias plasmáticas responsivas ao glucocorticoide.
Binds the minor groove of DNA at guanine: Amarra o pequeno sulco de DNA na guanina N2, dobrando a hélice em direção ao sulco maior e induzindo o reparo de transcrição-excisão nucleotídica – DNA dependente de dupla fita quebra. Modula o microambiente tumoral pelo agotamento de macrófagos associados ao tumor.
Binds tubulin → blocks microtubule polym: Binds tubulin → blocks microtubule polymerization + mitotic spindle → metaphase arrest + apoptosis. Less neurotoxic than vincristine, more myelotoxic.
Binds tubulin, prevents microtubule poly: Ligações tubulina, previne a polimerização de microtubulos, bloqueia a formação de fusos mitóticos → prende células em metafase, induz a apoptose.
Binds type-I interferon receptor (IFNAR): Receptor de interferão tipo I (IFNAR), induzindo sinalização JAK-STAT → aumento da regulação da MHC-I, atividade de células NK, polarização Th1, efeito antiproliferativo direto. Em ATLL, sintoniza- se com zidovudina (AZT/IFN-α) induzindo apoptose de células infectadas com HTLV-1.
Binet A (Binet 1981) = <3 involved lymph: Binet A (Binet 1981) = <3 involved lymphoid areas (cervical, axillary, inguinal +/- liver/spleen) AND Hb ≥10 g/dL AND plt ≥100K. Median OS >10 yr. iwCLL 2018 + ESMO + NCCN concur: Binet A without active disease criteria (progressive cytopenia, bulky/symptomatic lymphadenopathy, doubling lymphocytes <6 mo, autoimmune cytopenia refractory to steroids, B-symptoms) does NOT meet treatment indication. CLL12 (Langerbeins 2019) showed ibrutinib monotherapy in Binet A high-genetic-risk improved EFS but not OS — early treatment in stage A remains non-standard outside trials.
Binet B = ≥3 lymphoid areas, no cytopeni: Binet B = ≥3 áreas linfóides, sem citopenia, mediana da SG ~5-7 anos. Binet C = anemia (Hb < 10) ou trombocitopenia (plt < 100K) devido à infiltração da medula, mediana da SG ~2-3 anos sem terapêutica direcionada moderna. iwCLL 2018 critérios de doença ativa são cumpridos pelo Binet C e pelo Binet B progressivo; suporta a transição para terapêutica sistémica. 1L opções por CLL14 (ven+G fixo 12 mo), iLLUMINATO (ibrutinib+G), ELEVATE-TN (acalabrutinib +/- G), SEQUOIA (zanubrutinib). A direcção é intensificada apenas em relação à linha de base de observação e espera do Binet A.

O esquema de dosagem gradual (1 mg → 2 mg → 60 mg → 30 mg) mitiga o SRC de primeiro ciclo, limitando a ativação inicial das células T. Limita o tempo (8 ciclos ou até CR).
Bispecific antibody construct (half-life: Construção de anticorpos biespecíficos (formato BiTE de meia-vida estendida, andaime IgG-like) ligando delta-like ligand 3 (DLL3) em células tumorais de células pequenas-pulmonares e CD3ε em células T, formando uma sinapse imunológica redirecionada pelo tumor que ativa a matança de células T citotóxicas policlonais de células tumorais que expressam o DLL3. DLL3 é um inibidor Notch ligand aberrantemente expresso na superfície de ~85-95% dos tumores SCLC, mas minimamente em tecidos normais, tornando-o um alvo seletivo do tumor. Distinto do blinatumomab (anti-CD19 × CD3 BiTE para B-ALL) em: (1) alvo de tumor sólido (DLL3 em SCLC) vs hematológico; (2) semi-vida mais longa (~Fc-extendida) permitindo a dosagem de bolo q2w IV em vez de perfusão contínua; (3) requer uma dosagem acelerada (1 mg ciclo 1 dia 1) com monitorização hospitalar para atenuar a síndrome de liberação de citocinas (CRS). Não requer testes DLL3 pré-tratamento para uso no rótulo — a maioria dos SCLCs são DLL3-positiv...
Bispecific single-chain antibody constru: Construção biespecífica de anticorpos de cadeia única ligando CD19 às neoplasias por células B e CD3 às células T, formando uma sinapse imunológica que ativa a morte de células T citotóxicas policlonais de blastos de CD19+. Blastoid or pleomorphic histologic variant of mantle cell lymphoma — ~10-15% of MCL at diagnosis, biology aggressive (Ki-67 typically >50%, often co-mutated TP53/CDKN2A), poor response to chemoimmunotherapy (BR, R-CHOP, R-DHAP) with median OS <2 years on cBTKi. ZUMA-2 (Wang NEJM 2020) established brexucabtagene autoleucel (KTE-X19) for R/R MCL post-cBTKi (ORR 91%, CR 68%, mPFS not reached at 24 mo). Routes blastoid/pleomorphic MCL to CAR-T prioritization at 2L (post-cBTKi or post-chemoimmuno failure) over alloHCT or further chemoimmuno.
Blastoid/pleomorphic + TP53-mutant MCL h: Blastoide/pleomórfico + MCL mutante TP53 tem má resposta ao quimioimuno (BR/R-CHOP/R-DHAP) — impacto de sobrevivência substancial. Rota direta para BTKi-baseado (acalabrutinib + rituximab; consolidação com allo-SCT ou CAR-T na progressão).
Blastoid/pleomorphic morphology + TP53 a: Blastoid/pleomorphic morphology + TP53 acquisition often co-occur and predict chemoimmuno-resistance. Distinct from RF-MCL-BLASTOID-OR-TP53 (which captures these features at diagnosis as biology) — this RF triggers when morphologic conversion / refractoriness emerges during or after 1L therapy. Brexucabtagene autoleucel (ZUMA-2 — Wang NEJM 2020) ORR 87%, CR 62% in r/r MCL post-BTKi; preferred consolidation for chemo-refractory. BTKi + venetoclax + obinutuzumab (BOVen) per Le Gouill ASH 2021 highly active in TP53-mut. AlloHCT remains curative-intent option in young fit r/r MCL.

Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity is dose-dep: Bleomycin pulmonary toxicity is dose-dependent (cumulative >270 IU) and risk-elevated by baseline DLCO <60%, age >40, smoking, prior thoracic RT, renal dysfunction. RATHL trial (Johnson 2016) established PET2-negative-then-AVD safety, halving bleomycin exposure without PFS loss. For autoSCT conditioning: BEAM (BCNU 300 mg/m²) carries 10-20% pneumonitis at DLCO <60% — substitute LEAM (lomustine) or BeEAM (bendamustine) per institutional preference. For ICI: prior pneumonitis grade ≥2 contraindicates rechallenge.

Breakthrough CINV (adult): 10-20 mg PO/I: Breakthrough CINV (adult): 10-20 mg PO/IV/IM every 4-6 hours as needed, max 30 mg/day or 0.5 mg/kg/day for routine use; total duration limited to ≤5 days per EMA / FDA restrictions to minimize tardive dyskinesia risk. High-dose CINV (historical, pre-5-HT3- antagonist era): 1-2 mg/kg IV q2h × 3-5 doses with diphenhydramine premed for EPS — now rarely used outside salvage. Renal impairment: reduce dose ~50% if CrCl <60 mL/min (renal excretion). Hepatic: caution. Pediatric: 0.1 mg/kg PO/IV q6h, max 0.5 mg/kg/day, ≤5 days. Elderly (>65 yrs): start 5 mg with extended interval (q8h); higher tardive dyskinesia risk.
